description: This file defines a REST controller advice class that maps specific checkout-related exceptions to HTTP responses for the checkout service.

classes.name: ApiExceptionHandler
classes.description: Handles specific exceptions thrown within the checkout API and maps them to appropriate HTTP responses.

methods.name: handleValidation
methods.description: Handles validation exceptions related to checkout validation errors, returning a 400 Bad Request.

methods.name: handleBeanValidation
methods.description: Handles request validation errors for invalid method arguments, returning a 400 Bad Request.

methods.name: handleInventoryReservation
methods.description: Handles inventory reservation exceptions, returning a 409 Conflict.

methods.name: handleOrchestration
methods.description: Handles orchestration failures, returning a 502 Bad Gateway.
